The order of work

Rake, edge, weed, shake, tuck, blow

  1. RAKE OUT

    Old straw cleared and bagged

    |||| STEP 1 OF 6

  2. CUT THE LINE

    Spade-cut bed line, measured in feet

    |||| STEP 2 OF 6

  3. PULL WEEDS

    Weeds pulled by hand, bags counted

    |||| STEP 3 OF 6

  4. SHAKE LOOSE

    Bale shaken, not dumped

    |||| STEP 4 OF 6

  5. TUCK UNDER

    Straw tucked against the cut edge

    |||| STEP 5 OF 6

  6. BLOW CLEAN

    Walks and driveway blown off

    |||| STEP 6 OF 6

What we do

Every service, counted and ticketed

  • Pine straw installation

    Spread three inches deep fresh, about 35 square feet per bale, settling to two.

    Price it

  • Pine straw delivery

    Bales counted off the trailer and stacked where you want them, ticket in hand.

    Price it

  • Long-leaf pine straw

    Needles ten inches and longer, measured from a bale before it leaves the yard.

    Price it

  • Bed edging

    Every bed edge measured in feet first, then cut, so the count matches the yard.

    Price it

  • Bed cleanup and weeding

    Weeds and old straw cleared, with the number of bags hauled written on your ticket.

    Price it

  • Mulch installation

    Hardwood mulch by the cubic yard, two to three inches deep, depth checked with a ruler.

    Price it

  • New construction beds

    Bare-dirt beds on a new house measured, edged and covered before the first rain.

    Price it

  • Move-in and move-out refresh

    Beds made ready for a rental turnover, a listing or a new set of orders.

    Price it

  • Annual programs

    Two spreads a year at a set bale count, booked spring and fall in advance.

    Price it

What homeowners count

Tickets checked, bales verified

4.8 out of 5 · 142 reviews Sample rating

If your ticket says more bales than we spread, every missing bale comes off the bill.

  • Sample review
    I grew up baling straw outside Lakeland, so I counted. Ticket said 52 bales, I counted 52 empty strings in the trailer. Coverage was right too, I stuck a ruler in two beds and got a little over three inches.
    Hoyt B., Valdosta · Pine straw installation
  • Sample review
    We were leaving Moody on orders and needed the beds done before the move-out inspection. They measured, gave me a count by text, and it was finished two days later.
    Shanice T., Valdosta · Move-in and move-out refresh

    Rodney F., Hahira · Pine straw installation
